posts.caption:
Four people. Two years. One small game, made in Lisbon.

Tomorrow we release Saltmarsh Courier, a cozy delivery game about a postal courier in a tidal village. These are five screenshots from the build we're shipping.

With a team this size, everyone does a bit of everything. We wouldn't have it any other way.

If you've followed along, thank you. If you're new here: it's out on Steam on Thursday 12 November.

posts.title: Devlog 4: How we built the tide system in Saltmarsh Courier
posts.caption:
The tide decides when your letters arrive, so the tide had to work. In this devlog we walk through how we built the tide system for Saltmarsh Courier.

Saltmarsh Courier is out now on Steam: https://brightline.example/saltmarsh
